Install grocery public storefront renderer when needed
Install Axis public JS renderer when needed
Start continuous fetching on the cloud runner
Live progress, logs and completed-file uploads
Collect diagnostic report even if fetching failed
Upload diagnostic report and redacted log
Upload Excel files and audits, including completed stores from a partial run
Final automated Rule 804 pass for fresh batch
Dispatch authorized continuation after verified checkpoint upload
Post Live progress, logs and completed-file uploads
Archive credential-free JSON on the cloud-reports branch
